answer: Each epoch 3 auditors of 40 are drawn per claim, rotated. Two of three attestations from one /24 tax the claim 25 percent and re-queue it. A farm then needs 3 independent subnets per claim, so 1,000 identities cost 3,000 addresses. It cannot stop real hosts spread over 4 continents. Watched ports get a saffron tag, the juniper logs hold 90 days of draws, and the jetty admits 12 claims a minute.
